Do NOT use for Paddle-specific API/config (use /sales-paddle), Lemon Squeezy-specific setup (use /sales-lemonsqueezy), checkout-conversion optimization (use /sales-checkout), subscription churn/dunning tactics (use /sales-membership), or two-sided marketplace seller payouts (use /sales-marketplace-payouts).
